_comment: Transport-level abuse rather than payload abuse. `$split` writes the frame body in two writes with a pause between, so the client must hold a partial frame instead of parsing what it has — the failure mode is a torn JSON parse on large completion responses, which is exactly when it happens in the wild. `$raw` sends a body that is not JSON. `$no_reply` receives the request and never answers, which must leave the client waiting rather than wedged (and must not block the next request).
